p.src: 1  Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!

en: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
u.src: 1  Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!

en:
148:1 Hebrew: יה Yah
148:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 2  Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!

en: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!
u.src: 2  Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!

p.src: 3  Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!

en: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!
u.src: 3  Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!

p.src: 4  Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.

en: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.
u.src: 4  Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.

p.src: 5  Let them praise the LORD’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.

en: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.
u.src: 5  Let them praise the LORD’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.

p.src: 6  He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.

en: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.
u.src: 6  He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.

p.src: 7  Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,

en: Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,
u.src: 7  Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,

p.src: 8  lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,

en: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,
u.src: 8  lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,

p.src: 9  mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

en: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
u.src: 9  mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

p.src: 10  wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,

en: wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,
u.src: 10  wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,

p.src: 11  kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,

en: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,
u.src: 11  kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,

p.src: 12  both young men and maidens, old men and children.

en: both young men and maidens, old men and children.
u.src: 12  both young men and maidens, old men and children.

p.src: 13  Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

en: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
u.src: 13  Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

p.src: 14  He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise the LORD!

en: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise the LORD!
u.src: 14  He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise the LORD!
